civilopediaText.text: How space and time originated is not well understood. The fundamental topology of the universe is also a subject of debate. Here, we believe the Big Bang hypothesis.

Only space and time exist here. It is a state of perfect symmetry, where nothing has yet distinguished itself from anything else. It may appear as though there is nothing, yet time endures, and energy remains
A spin-2 particle appeared from the early symmetry violation, and it was called the graviton.

Photons, the particles with zero mass are created. Due to they lack mass, they travel through space at the speed of light. However, in the early universe, photons could not travel in a straight line due to scattering by free electrons.
Particles bound together by a strong attractive force form the first atomic nuclei.
When electrons are drawn in by electromagnetic force and join this structure, it becomes a highly stable state. This is hydrogen.

The only elements produced by these fundamental forces are, at most, hydrogen and helium. Eventually, these gases gather in regions of strong gravity to form stars. High-purity helium and hydrogen are ideal for nuclear fusion. Thus, stars begin to function as natural fusion reactors, generating vast amounts of energy and producing metallic elements.

Meteorite impacts, volcanic activity, and lightning strikes combined on the primordial planet to produce amino acids. In warm waters, these amino acids formed proteins, which then bonded with phosphorus to create nucleotides. It construct the DNA. Finally, the DNA became encased in a protein membrane. The Life is cooked.
